entities.summary: Romy Eggimann is a Swiss ice hockey forward who plays with the Ladies Team Lugano in the Swiss Women's Hockey League A and internationally for the Swiss women's national team. She has represented Switzerland at the Winter Olympics in 2014 and won the bronze medal after defeating Sweden in the bronze medal playoff.
